content: {"episode_id":"ep-05050","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring on episode ep-05050. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope accompanied by palpitations, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia, consistent with the submitted diagnosis codes R55 and I47.1. Given the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation during daily activities, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered to capture potential arrhythmic events. We request reconsideration of the denial based on this documented medical necessity for the outstanding balance of 634.27."}
